title: Incredible Product! Must have for any beer aficionado!
text:
Incredible Product! Must have for any beer aficionado!. Amazing!
Filled the growler at my local watering hole with a draft micro brew at 1pm. Put it in my car trunk as I finished errands in 95 degree heat. Enjoyed a cold pint from it at 7pm that evening & then left it on my kitchen counter top overnight. Next day, a full 24 hours after filling it with cold beer, I poured another pint....STILL COLD and CARBONATED! No perspiration on the growler, no flavor loss, and all of a 18 degree difference a day later -- without refrigeration and after being subjected to the Texas summer heat.

product_metadata.title: MiiR Stainless Steel Insulated Growler Bottle, 64-Ounce
features: Keeps cold things cold for 24+ hours, and hot things hot for up to 12 hours
description: The MiiR double-walled vacuum insulated 64oz growler is your go-to for carrying your favorite brew. The pristine 18/8 Korean stainless steel guarantees that the only thing you taste is that perfect beverage, and not metal. To ensure a perfect seal, MiiR took threads out of the equation and went with a classic clamp style closure system. In addition to trapping in freshness, this system keeps your cold things cold for 24+ hours and your hot things hot for 8+ hours. As if you needed another reason to love this growler, MiiR invests proceeds from every growler to provide one person in need with access to clean water. To prove their impact they include a coded bracelet that unveils GPS coordinates and photos of the well project you help build. Transparency is a beautiful thing.
